name: Whispering Shore
summary: Along Tirisfal Glades' western coast, the Whispering Shore lies north of Solliden Farmstead. Hostile murlocs claim its waters.

sections.title: A Ruined Haven
sections.body: Before the Third War, Lordaeron's fishermen came to the Whispering Shore for calm water and plentiful catches. Now the Great Sea breaks against an empty coast. Its waters are cold and dark, and travelers descending from the hills risk ambush by murlocs along the shore.

sections.title: The Murloc Menace
sections.body: Hostile murlocs claim the beach and attack anyone who approaches the surf. Their chieftain, Muad, leads them as they guard the shallows and tidal flats. Nearby roads and Solliden Farmstead are under threat.

faq.q: Where is the Whispering Shore located?
faq.answer: The Whispering Shore runs along Tirisfal Glades' western coast, directly north of Solliden Farmstead.

faq.q: What used to be at the Whispering Shore before the Scourge?
aliases: what was whispering shore used for
faq.answer: Before the Scourge, local fishermen came to the shore for calm waters and plentiful catches.

faq.q: Who controls the Whispering Shore now?
faq.answer: A hostile tribe of murlocs controls the coastline under Muad, their chieftain. They attack anyone who approaches the water.

faq.q: Can you still fish peacefully at the Whispering Shore?
faq.answer: No. Hostile murlocs guard the shore's cold, dark waters, and the catches are no longer plentiful.

angles.text: As Forsaken securing western Tirisfal Glades, you face an unruly murloc threat along the edge of your holdings at Whispering Shore.
